note: Rejudged after xfrmStateFromParams acquired the xfrmStateScopeFromParams call. RFC 4301 Section 4.2 says: Note: A compliant implementation MUST NOT allow instantiation of an ESP SA that employs both NULL encryption and no integrity algorithm. The scope projection adds no transform and does not bypass planStateAlgos or xfrmAuthName. Every non-AEAD ESP state still requests an Auth transform, and an empty or none algorithm is refused before a state is returned. TestRFC4301ESPNullEncryptionWithIntegrityIsInstantiated asserts the null cipher and HMAC-SHA-256 transform; TestRFC4301ESPNullEncryptionWithoutIntegrityIsRefused requires an error and nil state for absent and none integrity. The VPP negative requires ErrNotSupported and no SAD message, with a successful valid-SA control. The OSPF configuration pair rejects absent integrity and accepts SHA-256. The paired boundary assertions distinguish the forbidden combination from legitimate integrity-only ESP.
